title: bb_migrate: decision rules, accounting, read-only invariant, refusals

checks.name: contract: registry has bb_migrate
contract: description does not claim generation or compilation
checks.detail: Read-only single or batch migration planning with dependency order, explicit eff

checks.name: contract: modes = [plan]
contract: format is a separate text/json property
contract: targetLanguage is required
contract: every selector is documented
contract: legacy alias is marked legacy
checks.detail: legacy single-symbol alias for symbolNames; when both are su

checks.name: read-only: every index open passes { readonly: true }
read-only: the predicate detects a read-write open [negative]
checks.detail: a read-write open is flagged, a read-only open is not

checks.name: refusals: blank name/id/path entries are refused by name
refusals: the target language is trimmed before validation
refusals: the legacy alias unions with symbolNames
refusals: the union predicate rejects a dropped alias [negative]

checks.name: resolution: an exact same-file spelling resolves to that component
resolution: a cross-file collision is refused with candidate ids
resolution: an unknown name is refused as missing-symbol
resolution: the ambiguity predicate rejects a silent first match [negative]
checks.detail: a silent first match does not satisfy the refusal-and-name predicate

checks.name: methodology: base is 4h per planned component
methodology: one shared edge is charged once
methodology: structural edges are shown but not charged
methodology: an unmapped library per file is charged once
methodology: by-kind hours sum to relationshipHours
methodology: the rates are published as data
methodology: the arithmetic predicate rejects a wrong total [negative]
checks.detail: a total that is not the sum of its parts does not satisfy the identity

checks.name: order: a dependency-first order places every dependency before its dependent
order: the order predicate detects a reversed edge [negative]

order: a cycle is named and never reported complete

order: no relationships at all is `no-edges`
